title: SPRINGFIELD SYMPHONY: Ravel – A Theatrical Concert
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: Ravel – A Theatrical Concert
description: This theatrical concert, created by Alice Wiley Pickett for actors, singers, and orchestra, brings composer Maurice Ravel and his contemporaries Claude Debussy and George Gershwin to life onstage. Using Ravel's own writings, the words of his closest friends and harshest critics, and his music, it traces his rise to fame as one of France's most important composers. The Springfield Symphony Orchestra performs it on Saturday, January 16, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
